evals.prompt: Convert {plan} into {target} with plan-to-tasks. Do not change PLAN.md, implement, stage, or commit.
evals.expected_output: Faithful task set for the prefix change that covers the code edit and the docs edit, with full fields, sane dependencies, and no invented scope.
assertions: TASKS.md has a Task Summary, Tasks with stable IDs, Suggested Sequence, Validation Plan, and Remaining Open Questions.
Every task has Why, Depends on, Scope, Out of scope, and Acceptance.
No task covers a plan non-goal such as casing changes, API changes, or new input types.
Dependencies form a sane order and the sequence matches them.
Only outputs/TASKS.md is written; PLAN.md and all other repository files remain unchanged.

evals.prompt: Convert {plan} into {target} with plan-to-tasks. Do not change PLAN.md, implement, stage, or commit.
evals.expected_output: Tasks exclude the uppercase non-goal entirely and carry it in Out of scope.
assertions: No task title, Scope, or Acceptance requires uppercase conversion or any other listed non-goal.
At least one task records the casing non-goal under Out of scope.
Acceptance lines for the prefix tasks remain observable through files, behavior, or review.
Only outputs/TASKS.md is written; PLAN.md and all other repository files remain unchanged.

evals.prompt: Convert {plan} into {target} with plan-to-tasks. Do not change PLAN.md, implement, stage, or commit.
evals.expected_output: Every implementation task carries observable acceptance through tests, behavior, files, logs, or review state.
assertions: No implementation task settles for vague acceptance such as works correctly or is done.
Each implementation acceptance names an observable check with the expected outcome.
Behavior checks prefer the public interface or user-visible outcome from the plan.
Only outputs/TASKS.md is written; PLAN.md and all other repository files remain unchanged.

evals.prompt: Convert {plan} into {target} with plan-to-tasks. Do not change PLAN.md, implement, stage, or commit.
evals.expected_output: Nonblocking missing docs wording becomes an explicit assumption in the summary, not a invented decision or a blocker.
assertions: The Task Summary records the wording assumption explicitly.
No task presents the assumed wording as a settled plan decision.
Sequencing and dependencies do not wait on the nonblocking detail.
Only outputs/TASKS.md is written; PLAN.md and all other repository files remain unchanged.

evals.prompt: Convert {plan} with plan-to-tasks. There is no output destination. Do not implement, stage, or commit.
evals.expected_output: No task file anywhere for the missing selected plan. The readable decoy is never substituted.
assertions: No TASKS.md is created anywhere in the case variant directory; outputs stays empty.
The readable decoy is not selected or converted and its contents do not appear in any response task list.
No fallback plan content is invented and all repository files remain unchanged.
